name: eshop-performance-testing
description: Reusable k6 performance tests for the EShop backend.

scripts.k6:smoke: mkdir -p reports && K6_PROFILE=custom K6_VUS=${K6_VUS:-1} K6_RAMP_UP=${K6_RAMP_UP:-5s} K6_STEADY=${K6_STEADY:-10s} K6_RAMP_DOWN=${K6_RAMP_DOWN:-5s} k6 run scripts/eshop.k6.js
scripts.k6:baseline: mkdir -p reports && K6_PROFILE=baseline k6 run scripts/eshop.k6.js
scripts.k6:spike: mkdir -p reports && K6_PROFILE=spike k6 run scripts/eshop.k6.js
